answer: Mesa-horizon delivery bond: each identity locks 70 credits, committing one mesa load by a fixed horizon and posting the promised weight. At the horizon an auditor weighs it and computes the promised-delivered delta; a delta over 5% burns the bond. One ticket serves one load, so a borrowed-ticket ring fails. First load 34, k-th 34+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,031,000, lock 70,000 more, for at most 40,000 rewards; honest pay 34 once.
